verdict.rationale: Luma documents Luma Agents for multi-step video and image workflows. These agents research, generate, and refine assets on their own. Luma Skills promises 'Build a Creative Workflow Once, Run It Forever,' which points to reusable automated workflows. However, the evidence never shows triggers, scheduling, or unattended execution in the background, so delivery of true background automation is unproven. Missing for 10: documented scheduling or event triggers, explicit background or unattended run mode, depth on how Skills execute, independent or hands-on corroboration.
